test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls — A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing the North (but not necessarily in the same order). D sits third to the right of C, who sits at second position from the left end. E is the immediate neighbour of B and C. G sits to the left of C. A sits at second position from the right end. Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: F sits at the extreme left end.
B sits exactly between D and A.
F sits at the extreme right end.
E sits to the immediate left of D.

solution:
Given: Seven girls — A, B, C, D, E, F and G.

1) A sits at second position from the right end.

2) D sits third to the right of C, who sits at second position from the left end. 

3) E is the immediate neighbor of B and C.
